en.masthead_text: Official Data & Open API Platform of OLX Group Indonesia
en.mh_col1_desc: All market aggregations, secondhand price indices, and liquidity data are officially served from OLX Indonesia servers through secure protocols.
en.mh_col2_desc: Freely integrable for academic research, banking analysis, insurance valuation, and smart application development.
en.mh_col3_desc: Published data consists of anonymized aggregate metrics compliant with Indonesian consumer data protection standards.
en.hero_badge: Indonesia's Largest Market Intelligence & Data Aggregation Platform
en.hero_desc: Explore secondary market price indices, vehicle trading liquidity, property valuations, and consumer demand trends across 38 provinces.
en.vert_sub: Verified secondary transaction data, dealer offer aggregations, and online market liquidity parameters across Indonesia.
en.v1_desc: Four-wheeler vehicle valuation indices, annual depreciation, and average time-to-sell per segment.
en.v2_desc: Asking prices per square meter in Greater Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, and emerging satellite cities.
en.v3_desc: 150cc scooter market share, used electric motorcycle conversion, and active ad volumes per region.
en.v4_desc: Price retention trends for iPhones and previous-generation Android flagships relative to new product releases.
en.v5_desc: Logistics trucks, MSME pickup trucks, and secondary industrial equipment turnover across manufacturing hubs.
en.v6_desc: Inter-city liquidity maps (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), COD transaction speed, and ad reach radii.
en.view_all_datasets: View all 1,800+ Indonesian secondary market datasets
en.val_sub: Reliable data foundation for multifinance companies, banks, research consultants, and industry players.
en.feat1_desc: Access fair price calculations based on millions of active and historical listing points to mitigate automotive credit and mortgage financing risks.
en.feat3_desc: Understand how quickly a vehicle model or house type is absorbed by the market at the subdistrict, district, and city municipal levels.
en.feat4_desc: Receive periodic updates and secondary commodity price volatility alerts when significant market fluctuations occur.
en.ds_sub: Direct data feeds powering multifinance, banking, and industry analyst insights.
